definition: Unique identifier for each machine-surfaced candidate passage (review queue row).
Identifier for the retrieval/coding run that generated the candidate row; links to run_log.csv.
Identifier for the reviewer/coder who screened the candidate passage.
ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) of the review action recorded for this candidate row.
Short name of the intergovernmental organisation (IGO) to which the document/passage pertains.
Governance attribute code targeted by retrieval (YE, SCL, SJ, SMJ, SoJ, DO, STR, IIR, VC, HC).
Indicator identifier within the attribute (granular retrieval hook); corresponds to the indicator matrix.
Evidence tier within the three-tier template (Definition/Identification; Explanation/Elaboration; Substantiation/References).
Title of the source document from which the passage was extracted.
Official URL (or archived URI) for the source document; recorded for provenance.
Document type (e.g., treaty, statute, resolution, strategic plan, report, MoU).
Scope classification of the source (e.g., founding/constitutive vs operational/strategic).
Locator string for the cited location (article/section; page reference where relevant).
PDF page number where the passage occurs (as extracted from the local PDF file).
Short, human-readable excerpt (≤50 words) used for screening; may include ellipses to indicate omitted text.
Full excerpt captured for evidence; may include ellipses for non-contiguous quoting while retaining meaning.
Keyword/phrase that triggered retrieval of this candidate passage.
Retrieval method used to surface the candidate (e.g., keyword/regex; similarity-based).
Score from the retrieval method (if applicable); used for ranking/triage, not as evidence quality.
Screening decision recorded by the coder (Accept; Reject; Retag).
Coder memo capturing the rationale for the screening action and any interpretive boundary notes.
Final attribute code after any retagging (equals attribute_code unless coder_action=Retag).
Final indicator id after any retagging (equals indicator_id unless coder_action=Retag).
Unique identifier for each retained evidence record exported to the traceability archive.
Stable key for joining evidence records across exports (IGO × attribute × indicator × tier × source locator).
IGO name to which the evidence is assigned.
Governance attribute code for the matrix cell (see candidate review queue).
Indicator identifier within the attribute.
Evidence tier (Definition/Identification; Explanation/Elaboration; Substantiation/References).
Decision status for this evidence record (typically Accept or Retag in the traceability export).
Coded value stored for the IGO–attribute cell; may be a scalar value or a short descriptor.
Composed matrix-cell narrative generated from the three-tier template and citations for the IGO–attribute.
Coder note capturing why the passage substantiates the attribute and any boundary conditions.
Title of the evidence source document.
Document type classification.
Evidence scope (founding/constitutive vs operational/strategic).
Official URL (or archived URI) recorded for the source document.
PDF page number where the passage occurs (where applicable).
Locator string (article/section; page reference where relevant).
Short excerpt used for traceability display (≤50 words).
Full excerpt retained as the evidence artefact; may include ellipses for omissions.
Derived document-family label used to apply evidence hierarchy rules in integration diagnostics.
Year associated with the source document (when available).
Unique identifier for each decision-log event (audit trail entry).
ISO 8601 timestamp of the logged event.
Identifier for the coder/reviewer responsible for the event.
Pipeline step identifier (e.g., Step3 Review; Step4 Integration).
Event category (e.g., PASSAGE_REVIEW; RETAG; NOTE_EDIT; INTEGRATION_CHECK).
Action taken (Accept; Reject; Retag; or other audit events).
IGO associated with the event.
Attribute code before retagging (if applicable).
Attribute code after retagging (if applicable).
Indicator id before retagging (if applicable).
Indicator id after retagging (if applicable).
Final attribute code after retagging or confirmation.
Final indicator id after retagging or confirmation.
Evidence tier involved in the event (where applicable).
Short rationale string explaining the decision; complements review_note.
Extended coder memo documenting contextual interpretation, boundary rules, and justification.
Boolean flag indicating whether the evidence was retained in the traceability long file.
Run identifier linking the event to run metadata (run_log.csv).
Version label for the controlled vocabulary/dictionary used in retrieval/coding.
Version label for the attribute/indicator tagset used in retrieval/coding.
Version label for the exported audit artefacts.
Unique identifier for a pipeline run (retrieval, screening, integration, diagnostics).
Pipeline stage (PartII-Step3 retrieval/screening; PartII-Step4 integration/diagnostics).
Identifier for the human operator running the pipeline.
ISO 8601 start time for the run.
ISO 8601 end time for the run.
Python interpreter version used for the run.
Flag indicating whether package versions were pinned for reproducibility.
SHA-256 hashes of key input files, used to verify identical inputs on re-run.
Serialized JSON of key run parameters and thresholds.
SHA-256 hashes of generated output files for integrity checking.
